# StatsLab EdTech R&D Ecosystem (Full Repository LLM Documentation)

## Executive Summary
StatsLab DSI is an open-source Research & Development (R&D) ecosystem integrating interactive statistical data visualization with Islamic ethical values (Amanah, Tabayyun, Tawazun) to foster data literacy among middle-school students based on the Watson-Callingham hierarchy (Levels 1–6) and Kurikulum Merdeka SMP Fase D (SK BSKAP No. 033/H/KR/2022 & No. 032/H/KR/2024).

Developed by **Muhammad Khoiruzzadittaqwa (muhzadit)** at the Department of **Tadris Matematika** (Pendidikan Matematika), **Institut Al-Bahjah Cirebon**, Indonesia.

- **Production URL:** https://dstatistika.pages.dev/
- **Repository URL:** https://github.com/zaditprodakwah/statslab
- **Kaggle Dataset:** https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/muhzadit/statslab-dsi-empirical-data

## Multi-Pillar Architecture

### Pillar 1: Production Web Applications
- **Edge Deployment (`apps/statslab-dsi`):** React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6.2, Hono 4.7 edge functions on Cloudflare Pages (`dstatistika.pages.dev`).
- **Web App (`apps/web`):** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5, Prisma v7 ORM with Neon PostgreSQL, Recharts, Zustand.

### Pillar 2: EdTech UX & Values Integration
- Islamic Ethical Pillars:
  - **Amanah (QS. Al-Mutaffifin: 1-3)**: Zero-based vs. Truncated Y-axis visual audit toggle for chart integrity.
  - **Tabayyun (QS. Al-Hujurat: 6)**: Outlier and spike detection (>20% from median) with data verification warnings.
  - **Tawazun (QS. Ar-Rahman: 7-9)**: Mean vs. Median distribution balance indicator.
- Watson-Callingham Data Literacy Framework:
  - 8 Embedded Tasks spanning Level 1 (Idiosyncratic) to Level 6 (Advanced Critical).
  - Automated Polytomous Scoring (PCM Rubric: 0, 1, 2).
- Usability & Practicality Evaluation:
  - System Usability Scale (SUS 14-item adaptive Brooke formula, empirical score = 68.0, Good Usability).

### Pillar 3: Open Science Empirical Data & Psychometrics
- Content Validity: Expert agreement index using Aiken's V ($V = 0.85, p < 0.05$ across 33 items, 6 judges).
- Practicality Evaluation: 4 multidisciplinary teachers (83.1%) and 31 Grade VII students.
- Qualitative Triangulation: CAQDAS REFI-QDA international XML codebook (Krippendorff's Alpha = 0.9476).
- Open Datasets: Hosted publicly on Kaggle Datasets (`muhzadit/statslab-dsi-empirical-data`) with CC-BY-SA-4.0 license.
